subject: SaaSify vendor launch — playbook & MAP alignment
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna.park@saasify.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — SaaSify / Redwood (kickoff & MAP)

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the quick intro call last week. SaaSify is ready to move forward with vendor setup so we can start the integration pilot. Before we get the PO over the wire, could we schedule a 30–45 minute vendor launch meeting next week to align on:

- Mutual Action Plan (timeline & owners)
- PO process and invoicing contacts
- Required procurement/contracting forms (W9, insurance, PO template)
- Success criteria and ramp milestones

We prefer Tue/Wed morning PT, but we can be flexible. I attached the onboarding form we usually fill out — happy to pre-populate answers if you send the PO/billing contact.

Attachments: SaaSify_Onboarding_Form.pdf (filled partial)

Best,
Jenna Park
Head of Partnerships, SaaSify Inc.
jenna.park@saasify.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — SaaSify / Redwood (kickoff & MAP)

Hi Jenna — thanks, this is perfect. We’d love to get a short launch call on the calendar and share a concise playbook so everyone lands on the same page. Proposed slots (PT):

- Tue 6/20, 10:00–10:40
- Wed 6/21, 09:30–10:00
- Wed 6/21, 11:00–11:40

Can you confirm which works and who from your side will attend?

For prep, I’m attaching:
- MAP_SaaSify_v1.xlsx — draft mutual action plan with suggested owners
- PO_Template_Redwood.docx — the PO layout our billing team prefers

Quick notes:
- Karthik (cc’d) will own PO intake & contracting with Procurement ops.
- Monica (cc’d) will support onboarding success metrics and the integration pilot.

Agenda I’m proposing:
1) Intros & roles (5m)
2) MAP walkthrough & timeline (10m)
3) PO & billing steps — required docs and lead times (10m)
4) Pilot success criteria & next steps (10m)
5) Q&A & action items (5m)

If you can complete the attached onboarding form before the call, we’ll be able to pre-seed the MAP and speed the PO route.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — SaaSify / Redwood (kickoff & MAP)

Lauren / Monica — looping in procurement items we should confirm before the call.

- PO owner at SaaSify (name & billing email) — we need a single billing contact for the invoice routing.
- Tax docs: W-9 (US) or W-8BEN if offshore. Please flag if SaaSify will invoice under a different legal entity.
- Insurance: if SaaSify requires any changes to our standard PO terms, notify early.
- Lead time: standard processing is ~10 business days from complete docs + signed PO. If they require faster processing, we can request an expedite but need internal approvals.

Suggested prep for the vendor: complete the onboarding form, attach W-9 and current invoice example (PDF), and confirm legal entity. I’ll draft the PO after the call and route for approvals—Monica, can you confirm the pilot budget owner so we attach the correct cost center?

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — SaaSify / Redwood (kickoff & MAP)

Thanks Jenna — Wed 6/21 09:30–10:00 PT works for our team. I’ve booked a 30-minute slot and sent a calendar invite to your address on file. Meeting details and prework below.

Prework (please complete before the call):
- Finish the attached SaaSify_Onboarding_Form.pdf with billing/legal details.
- Upload W-9 (or W-8BEN) + sample invoice to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSaaSifyOnboarding

Meeting agenda (confirmed):
- 5m: Introductions & stakeholder owners
- 10m: MAP_SaaSify_v1.xlsx — confirm timeline and owners (milestones: PO issued, integration pilot start, health check #1)
- 10m: PO & invoicing (Karthik) — required docs, expected processing time, and expedite options
- 5m: Success criteria & next steps — define pilot acceptance metrics and delivery checkpoints

Success criteria (we’ll use these to declare pilot ready):
- Integration stable on test environment for 72 hours with no critical errors
- Documentation handoff and runbook for customer support
- PO signed and invoice routed to billing with correct cost center

Attachments in this thread: MAP_SaaSify_v1.xlsx; PO_Template_Redwood.docx; SaaSify_Onboarding_Form.pdf

If anything changes on your side, let me know and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
